content.value: A band limited signal is expressed as 10 + 5 cos II10 ×10⁶t.
i) Sketch the spectrum of the signal.
ii) What will be the required channel band width to transmit this signal?
iii) Estimate thermal noise level of this channel when operated at 30º C.
iv) What signal power is required to achieve the intended capacity of 20 Mbps in this noisy channel?
